item.title: What if the Chicago Bears selected Patrick Mahomes at #2 instead of Mitch Trubisky?
item.description: What if the Chicago Bears didn’t take Mitch Trubisky in 2017? What if they drafted Patrick Mahomes instead? This one move could have completely rewritten NFL history - no Chiefs dynasty, no “Double Doink,” and Chicago with multiple Super Bowl rings. We break down the wild chain reaction that would’ve changed everything from Brady vs. Brees to Mahomes vs. Burrow in the Super Bowl. You won’t believe how different the league looks in this alternate reality.

item.title: The Day Football Stopped: The Ryan Shazier Story
item.description: In one chilling moment, Paul Brown Stadium fell silent. What began as a routine tackle turned into a life-altering tragedy for Steelers linebacker Ryan Shazier. This article explains the somber events of that night, the reactions of players and fans, and how one hit reshaped a career-and lives-forever.
